mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_token_usage (project_id, task_id, agent_id, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, user_id, session_id, source, create_time) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{agentId}, #{modelName}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{source}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) AS id FROM biz_token_usage WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
